_comment: DRAFT live tag-db-id -> 3-letter TAG table for the game build 16022851, solved 2026-06-24 by anchoring on the save-derived tag-db-id ordering and locating the in-memory std::string table, then VALIDATING via the already-proven division-owner field (1603/1603). UNCOMMITTED / awaiting merge into layout.16022851.json. Offsets are build-specific; the reader MUST refuse to run unless the live exe sha256 matches the build below. All reads are READ-ONLY. This REMOVES the save dependency for tag-db-id -> TAG identity (state owner/controller, division owner/controller all read a tag-db-id; this table resolves it live).

build.module_base_at_capture: 0x7FF783AD0000 (ASLR-randomized per launch; never hardcode - read live)

summary: The tag-db-id used by state owner/controller (+0xC8/+0xCC) and division owner/controller (+0x1C8/+0x1D0) is the 1-based index into a contiguous in-memory array of MSVC std::string country TAGs. Index 0 = the null-tag sentinel "---"; index 1 = GER, 2 = ENG, 3 = SOV, ... This 1-based index EXACTLY equals the order countries appear in the melted save's top-level countries={} block (0 mismatches vs the independently-derived owner map over 38 ids; and the table resolves 1603/1603 live division owners to the save TAG). So: TAG = tag_table[tag_db_id]; tag_db_id 0 means 'no country'.

tag_table_array.kind: Contiguous inline array of MSVC std::string (NOT a separately-headed std::vector: no external aligned qword in all committed memory holds the begin pointer; it is an inline member of a larger country-database object). DIRECT index by tag-db-id: record = base + tag_db_id*0x20. Slot [0] = "---" (null tag). Valid [1..143] this session.
tag_table_array.base_session_dynamic: 0x1F8139FB680 (index 0 = '---'; HEAP, changes every launch - relocate per session, see relocate_method).
tag_table_array.indexing: tag = read_msvc_sso_string(base + tag_db_id*0x20). tag_db_id is the SAME id space as state-owner (+0xC8/+0xCC) and division-owner (+0x1C8) fields.
tag_table_array.relocate_method: Per session: scan committed heap for the 128-byte anchor = the raw bytes of records index0..index3 ('---','GER','ENG','SOV'), each a cap-15 SSO std::string: bytes = chars + NUL pad to 16, then size(u64)=len, then cap(u64)=15. This anchor matched EXACTLY 2 sites in ~8 GB this session (the canonical table A and a secondary copy B) and ZERO false positives. DISAMBIGUATE to the canonical table by: (a) records 0..143 all valid SSO with size 1..15/cap 15, (b) NO duplicate non-sentinel tags (the secondary copy B duplicates D01-D04), (c) the record immediately past the active roster is invalid garbage. Prefer the candidate satisfying all three. Validate by resolving several live division owners (+0x1C8) and state owners (+0xC8) and confirming all ids are in-bounds and yield 3-char tags.

record_layout_msvc_std_string._coordinate_system: Offsets relative to a record base (base + id*0x20).

chars.note: the 3-char TAG, NUL-padded. When size<16 (always true for 3-char tags) the chars live inline here; otherwise +0x00 would be a heap pointer (never the case for tags).

size.note: string length = 3 for real tags (or 3 for '---').

capacity.note: SSO capacity = 15. A strong validity discriminator (require cap==15 && 0<size<=15).

validation.save_order_invariant: 1-based index into save countries={} order == in-memory tag-db-id: 0 mismatches vs the draft owner observed_map over 38 known ids.
validation.division_owner_crosscheck: DECISIVE: enumerated 1604 live divisions (vtable scan), read owner tag-db-id (+0x1C8), resolved via this table -> TAG, compared to the melted save's div_id->owner: 1603/1603 MATCH, 0 mismatches (the 1 live-only division was created after the save). This validates the table against the already-proven division-owner field, not merely against the save it was derived from.
validation.anchor_uniqueness: 128-byte index0..3 anchor matched exactly 2 sites in ~8 GB, both 143/143 GT tags; canonical table A is duplicate-free, secondary B duplicates D01-D04.

fail_closed_validators: first N fixed tags match expected order at least through HOL/CZE/POL (GER,ENG,SOV,SWE,FRA,LUX,BEL,HOL,CZE,POL)
every record is a valid MSVC SSO std::string: size in 1..15, cap == 15, NUL-padded, printable uppercase/digit chars (reject heap-string variants)
NO duplicate non-sentinel tags (the secondary copy B fails this with D01-D04 -> reject)
all live state owner/controller (+0xC8/+0xCC) and division owner (+0x1C8) tag-db-ids are in [0..count) and resolve to a 3-char tag; else mark layout broken
anchor matches >=1 site that disambiguates to the duplicate-free table; >1 surviving duplicate-free candidate that disagree -> fail closed
when >1 canonical candidate agrees on a shared prefix, do NOT accept the shortest unless it COVERS the max observed live tag-db-id (TagTable.covers over the live state+division owner ids) (Codex)
exe sha256 gate (same as locate.py): unknown build -> no publish

residual.tag_db_id_to_running_index_bridge: NOT solved. The country-array record (locate.py, rec0=0x1F8453A8A40) does NOT embed the 3-char TAG anywhere in its 0x120 bytes, and no embedded u16/u32 == tag-db-id was found at a fixed record offset. So linking a tag-db-id (or TAG) to the country-array running_index (which carries economy scalars: PP/stability/war_support/command_power/num_ships) is still unresolved in memory. NOT required for identity (TAG is fully resolved here) - only needed to attach economy scalars to a TAG live. Workaround: bridge via the save (PP-as-Rosetta), or solve the country object's stored tag-db-id in a follow-up.
residual.two_tables: A canonical (clean), B secondary (duplicates D01-D04). Use A; the disambiguation rule selects it. If a future build only exposes B-like duplicated tables, fall back to the FIRST occurrence of each tag (indices 1..143 are correct in B too; the dups are appended at the tail).
